title: Zombiecraft
description: Survive the zombie apocalypse with exclusive guns, unique upgrades, and immersive maps
body:
[![Zombiecraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4096a62f5eb68d1b8dd0461252ce8b8a1a3f7ef0.png)](https://v2.zombiecraft.net)
**Zombie apocalypse survival server** [![discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/716715975352909844?logo=discord&logoColor=ffffff&color=7389D8&labelColor=6A7EC2&label=Zombiecraft)](https://discord.gg/ysmTwvWNxa)
## About the server Zombiecraft is a co-op zombie survival Minecraft server where up to four players fight endless waves of zombies, unlocking new areas and upgrading gear along the way. Repair Barricades and find Mystery boxes, Perk machines, and Wall weapons to stay alive — **no mods required to play**!
